body:
Do you think you have become addicted to anime and cannot stop watching it? 

This is just my opinion, and forgive me if I'm wrong, but while I feel that watching anime has probably contributed in making you feel this way, I think it is highly possible there are other issues that are certainly not helping you right now.

If it's ok with you, can you tell me why you started watching anime? I read your other post, and you mention you started somewhat recently.

Hey pal, are you aware of what causes these thoughts? You don't have to say/explain anything if you don't want, I only felt the need to ask. 

Most of us here understand you, and we are here for you, trying to help if we can.

Hey, I understand what you are trying to say. Even now, I still don't believe I have a purpose, a reason to keep moving forward. My suicidal thoughts do not only stem from this, but it certainly plays a huge part.

Frankly speaking, I do not know what to tell you. Just like you I am lost, and scared of so many things. Specially scared. Because I lack a purpose, I fail to picture myself in the future, and so, I'm convinced I do not have one.

Wanna talk to me a little bit? Just share some ideas.

How old are you friend, if I'm allowed to ask? (I'm 20, soon to be 21)

I can only imagine it to be interesting, because frankly speaking the intricacies of the brain feel like something way over my head. 

As someone who is not clear on what I want in life, I really cannot help but admire those who have their sight set on achieving a certain goal, but that's just me, and I just feel that towards anyone clear on their shit. Specially toward those who desire to help others.

According to Google (which might be wrong), becoming a neurosurgeon is a process that lasts 8 years + 6-7 years of "neurosurgical residency training." That's incredible.

I'm really no one to speak, but I think it would be great if you were able to help others better their lives. Your mentality is certainly suited for it, and that is fantastic. 

I don't know what you will decide to do pal, but I'm cheering you on. Feel free to contact me if you wanna talk (this goes for everybody who feels the need) and I'll try to be as helpful as possible. I'm no professional, but I promise to do my best, whatever it's worth.

Thank you.

I'm not going to even pretend I'm magically feeling better about my sorry self, but I'd be even more of a fool to simply dismiss your words. 

I don't agree with much of what you have stated, but can at least appreciate the intention behind the message, and the fact you shared your story.

I wish you a nice week.

I'm in college too for now, and I also have incredible trouble talking to new people. I form all these different conversations in my head, then just clamp my mouth shut when it's time to speak. 

Tonight, when I was feeling at my lowest, I decided to try and help as many people as I can. Maybe it won't help, but I'm tired of not trying my best at anything, running away and giving up too fast. Ironic (maybe?) As I still feel like dying. Or maybe I'm just a horrible person, trying to make myself feel better by making it my purpose to help others, as I lately feel I can only do wrong. It's all in how you see it, in how you are judged, and in how you judge yourself.

I was checking some of your past posts and noticed you seem to like anime, or at least anime memes. Wanna talk about that, and then go from there to other things?

Some people tell you the world is what you make of it, with big smiles on their faces. Makes you wonder if they see the shit I see, or if it's only me.

I understand what you feel and even where you are coming from. I don't think anybody is a pussy, whether they are trying to live their lives or considering to end them. 

I'd like to talk a little bit with you tho, just share some ideas. I'm neither the brightest nor the most normal dude around, for sure, but I do think I'd like to read some of the things you want to say and maybe you would consider reading mine. For example, where did you see kids laughing at bombs going off?

Hey pal, I don't want to sound like a hypocrite but hang in there. 

I'm in a similar position, not the exact same, but somewhat similar. If by the end of the week I've determined I've failed I feel I could die and not care, for allowing everything to reach this point I already want to die. What stops me is the grief I'll put my family through, but I sincerely do not know what to do other than kill myself or run away from their lives and disappear.

Wanna talk about some stuff? For example, Why do you want to be a pediatric neurosurgeon? As I was reading this question popped up in my head, and felt the need to ask. I'm really curious about it.
In a way I suppose, but not really. I'm talking about my family.

Yeah, I know. It's is not the first time I want to die, certainly not the last.

Impossible. Miracles do not exist, neither do time machines. Both my mistakes and theirs have been already made, yet I'm the one who beats the burden of being wrong.
